\caption{Revenue maximization: certified approximation ratio of random greedy (RG, mean over trials) with respect to each upper bound, as a function of the cardinality $k$. $f(S)=\sum_{i\notin S}\sqrt{\sum_{j\in S} w_{ij}}$ with $w_{ij}\sim U(0,1)$. RG/OPT uses the exact optimum (brute force) where it was computable. On the largest instances the dual bound is minimized over every 5th or 10th greedy prefix only. Additional baselines: the LP over the dual's base sets (B2), the pruned double-greedy bound $\gamma_1$ (B3) and the modular bounds $\mu_2$, $\mu_3$ on the pruned lattice (B4); B3 and B4 bound the unconstrained optimum. Marginal is $\min_S f(S)+\mathrm{Pen}(S)+\sum_{a\in T_k(S)}[f(a\mid S)]^+$ ($T_k(S)$: the $k$ largest marginals) over the same base sets, i.e.\ the dual bound without its caps. Curves are means over graph/sample seeds.}
\label{fig:rg-revenue_max-wide-baselines}
